thread:
matt: getting a flood of missed pages from the relay, customers are reporting delayed alerts. paging gateway returns 502s and then ops-bot shows ack timeouts :alarm_clock:
priya: I'm oncall, standing up. are we seeing automation reroute attempts?
leo: digging into relay logs now, looks like ack-relay timed out ~15s then we tried automatic reroute to the backup webhook and that returned 400.
sarah: ops-bot posted a signing-rotation event earlier today at 09:12 UTC — could be related.
matt: yep, headers on the reroute requests are missing the X-Signature header, backup webhook rejects payloads without it.
leo: sample from logs:
```POST /v1/outbound HTTP/1.1
Host: carrier.example
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 482

{"to":"+1555xxxx","message":"ALERT: infra latency"}```
leo: note: payload includes some unicode chars from alert title, carrier rejects non-ASCII bytes on their older gateway.
priya: ok manual fallback — I'm starting the phone tree and sending manual SMS via oncall-phone. please confirm who has contacts.
oncall-phone: manual page sent to Tier 1 oncall, ack pending.
pager-relay: system: webhook response 400: "missing signature" for request id=aa3f4
matt: that matches the signing-rotation. ops-bot probably started using the new key format but the relay config didn't update.
sarah: confirmed — deployment of signing-rotation was gated but config push to relay failed for a subset of instances. rollout was partial.
leo: short-term mitigation: revert relay config to accept legacy signature format, or reapply new key to all proxy instances. which is faster?
priya: revert to legacy acceptance in relay now, we'll roll forward properly after tests. start a canary to verify.
matt: creating quick revert PR and patching the relay config on prod nodes. PR: https://git.redwood/relays/commit/fe8b2 (hotfix)
leo: applied patch to 3/3 relay workers in us-east-1, repeating in us-west-2.
priya: manual pages delivered to most oncall contacts, phone tree confirmed. customer-impact: a few customers got delayed alerts for ~12 minutes. we're treating as P2.
sarah: ops-bot note: rotation deployment rollback triggered at 09:38 UTC by matt.
ops-bot: system: revert completed, health checks OK, no further 502s observed for 10m.
matt: monitoring for 20m, will keep manual paging open until we see 30m clean.
leo: follow-up actions: 1) fix config push automation so signing keys are atomic across relay fleet 2) add payload ASCII sanitizer before sending to carrier 3) add test harness for backup webhook acceptance.
priya: assigning follow-ups to infra: @leo, @sarah. I'll draft post-incident note and customer impact summary.
matt: thanks everyone. we mitigated with manual pages + config revert. will escalate to oncall review in retro. :thumbsup:
